children: The number of people registering as jobless in Spain rose by 1.92% in August from a month earlier, or by 44,419, leaving a total of 2.36 million people out of work, data from the Labour Ministry showed on Wednesday.
Spain gained 83,844 net formal jobs in August to 22.37 million jobs, on a calendar-adjusted basis and excluding seasonality, a separate report from the Social Security Ministry showed.
